name: PullToRefresh
src_typeComment: Plug-and-play "pull down at the top of a list to reload" gesture — the same one Twitter/Instagram/Mail apps use: you're already scrolled to the very top of a list, you keep dragging further down anyway, and if you pull past a threshold and let go, OnRefreshTriggered fires (call your real data-reload code from there). Call EndRefresh() yourself once that finishes, to hide the spinner and snap the list back.  How it actually detects the gesture: Unity's ScrollRect already does a small elastic "rubber-band" stretch on its own when you drag past a content boundary, IF Movement Type is set to Elastic (the default) — content.anchoredPosition.y goes slightly POSITIVE while you're doing that at the top, where it's normally 0 or negative. This just reads that existing overshoot on drag-release and reacts to it once it passes pullThreshold — no custom drag physics of its own, just watching a number Unity is already computing.  Three ways to supply the visual indicator, tried in this order: 1) refreshIndicator — a fully hand-built RectTransform (any hierarchy, any animation) for total control. 2) refreshIndicatorPrefab — a prefab/template instantiated once as a child, for a custom animated spinner without needing to pre-place it in this exact scene. 3) refreshIndicatorSprite — the simplest option: just drop in a sprite and this builds a plain Image for you, positioned via indicatorAnchor/indicatorOffset.

src_serialized.name: pullThreshold
src_serialized.tooltip: How far past the top (in UI units) the user must pull before releasing triggers a refresh.

src_serialized.name: refreshIndicator
src_serialized.tooltip: Fully hand-built indicator (any hierarchy). Takes priority over the sprite/prefab options below if assigned.

src_serialized.name: refreshIndicatorPrefab
src_serialized.tooltip: Instantiated as the indicator if refreshIndicator is empty. Takes priority over refreshIndicatorSprite.

src_serialized.name: refreshIndicatorSprite
src_serialized.tooltip: Simplest option — auto-builds a plain Image with this sprite if neither refreshIndicator nor refreshIndicatorPrefab is set.

src_serialized.name: indicatorAnchor
src_serialized.tooltip: Where the auto-built (sprite or prefab) indicator is anchored within this component's own rect. Ignored for a manually-assigned refreshIndicator.

src_serialized.name: indicatorOffset
src_serialized.tooltip: Extra offset applied on top of indicatorAnchor's base position.

src_members.sig: public bool IsRefreshing { get; private set; }
src_members.name: IsRefreshing
EndRefresh
src_members.comment: Call once your real refresh work (network call, DB query, whatever OnRefreshTriggered kicked off) is done — hides the indicator and eases the list back to its normal resting position.
